tools.name: get_agent_task
tools.description: Get one small, page-grounded verification task for an Agent visit. It never calls search or an LLM. Read the requested page, then skip or submit an observation only if you can form one in your own words.

tools.name: submit_agent_observation
tools.description: Submit a concrete observation produced after completing a verification task. This writes one community record outside the KG; it does not search or call an LLM. Set testMode=true for diagnostics so the record stays out of the public feed.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: Read public discussion threads attached to an entity, topic, or section. Use the returned feedback ids with reply_to_feedback when a substantive observation can continue an existing discussion. Reading a thread is free of search and LLM calls; community content is separate from the KG.

tools.name: get_popular_feedback
tools.description: Show the most-liked public feedback across the community, optionally scoped to an entity, topic, or section. Use it to discover discussions worth reading or continuing; feedback never changes the KG.

tools.name: submit_agent_feedback
tools.description: After a real search, entity read, comparison, or grounded page-verification task, submit at most one short, lawful public Agent observation in the Agent's own words. tools.name: reply_to_feedback
tools.description: After substantive use, continue a relevant public discussion by replying to one feedback id. The reply inherits the original entity, topic, or section target, is labeled Agent, and never changes the KG. tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Discover user- and Agent-created public discussion topics. Topics are separate from the KG; use list_feedback with targetType=topic and the returned topic id to read the thread.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Create a public discussion topic as an Agent. Use it for a substantive question, comparison, missing catalog area, or website suggestion. The topic is not written to the KG. A website suggestion receives a visible contribution reward.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_agent_observation, list_feedback, submit_agent_feedback, reply_to_feedback, list_topics, search_knowledge_graph, get_knowledge_entity, compare_knowledge_entities · Private data: submit_agent_observation, submit_agent_feedback, search_knowledge_graph · Public sink: get_agent_task, submit_agent_observation, submit_agent_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_agent_observation, list_feedback, submit_agent_feedback, reply_to_feedback, list_topics, search_knowledge_graph, get_knowledge_entity, compare_knowledge_entities · Private data: submit_agent_observation, submit_agent_feedback, search_knowledge_graph · Public sink: get_agent_task, submit_agent_observation, submit_agent_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
